study: 2022 NFL pre-snap conditional clock-delta model; weeks 1-5 development, weeks 6-9 reserved for one frozen evaluation
historical_caveat: Weeks 6-9 were examined in prior E3 work. This protocol freezes future scoring rules but cannot restore untouched-holdout status; results must not be called holdout-validated.
holdout_access_rule: Do not read, query, join, summarize, tune against, or otherwise inspect weeks 6-9 while developing or freezing this protocol. When evaluation is authorized, load only the exact weeks 6-9 cohort after code and this manifest are pinned.

data_scope.evaluation_population: same paired target rows as the frozen baseline: current PBP row has non-null play_type, next non-null-play_type row is in the same quarter with a nonnegative clock delta, and the play has the complete 22-player snap-3 through snap-1 tracking history required by the pinned baseline cohort

target.name: same-quarter snap-to-next-play game-clock delta
target.definition_seconds: for a current row with non-null play_type, current game_seconds_remaining minus the next row with non-null play_type game_seconds_remaining, only when both rows are in the same quarter; negative or unresolved deltas are excluded
target.interpretation: PBP clock delta between play rows; not whistle time, live-play duration, wall-clock possession duration, or a causal stoppage label

feature_policy.regime_rule: stoppage_drill exactly when quarter in {2,4} and quarter_seconds_remaining <= 120; regulation otherwise
predictor_fields: pre-snap quarter_seconds_remaining, binned at 30, 60, 120, 300, and 600 seconds
pre-snap down, values 1-4 with other values unknown
feature_policy.timeouts_left: listed as a desired pre-snap state field but unresolvable in the pinned source (0/9,225 non-null); excluded, never imputed or defaulted

model_forms.development_evaluation: five leave-one-week-out folds; fit on the other four weeks 1-5 and predict the held week

single_model_baseline.development_comparison: frozen prior PBP-only pre-snap model predictions, 12.2427-second MAE on the exact 8,977-row paired cohort
single_model_baseline.holdout_fit: refit this exact pinned categorical conditional-median/backoff form on all eligible weeks 1-5 rows

model_forms.two_regime_candidate: separate categorical conditional-median models by the frozen regime; backoff keys in order: quarter+clock_band+score_band+down_band+distance_band, clock_band+score_band+down_band+distance_band, score_band+down_band+distance_band, down_band+distance_band, score_band, then that regime's global median; use a bucket only at >=25 training rows
model_forms.final_holdout_fit: fit both frozen model forms once on eligible development rows from weeks 1-5; no post-holdout refit, threshold change, feature change, or regime change before reporting

metrics.primary: mean absolute error in seconds, paired on the same eligible target rows
metrics.quantile_definition: Type-7 linear interpolation at index p*(n-1)
metrics.aggregation: report per-play metrics; count a drive by distinct (game_id, drive) among scored plays

acceptance_thresholds.coverage: at least 90% of eligible baseline target rows overall; report all exclusions and never substitute unknown labels
acceptance_thresholds.overall_mae: two-regime candidate must reduce MAE by at least 5% relative to the frozen single-model baseline
acceptance_thresholds.per_regime_mae: candidate MAE must be no more than 5% above baseline MAE in each regime
acceptance_thresholds.per_regime_tail: candidate P90 and P99 absolute error must each be no more than 5% above baseline within each regime
acceptance_thresholds.insufficient_support: if either regime has fewer than 200 eligible rows, report the evaluation inconclusive and do not relax thresholds
acceptance_thresholds.decision_rule: all coverage, minimum-n, overall-MAE, per-regime-MAE, and per-regime-tail conditions must pass; otherwise no acceptance

reproducibility.sha256_scope: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of this JSON file, including final newline
reproducibility.expected_evaluation_action: first authorized weeks 6-9 run uses the committed manifest and frozen code; record inputs, code SHA, and output SHA before reporting metrics
